third-law-book-table.alt: Left: the free-body diagram of a book at rest, with F_N, table on book, up and F_g, Earth on book, down, equal. They act on the same object, so they are not a third-law pair. Right: the book, table and Earth pulled apart. Single ticks mark the contact pair, table on book up and book on table down; double ticks mark the gravity pair, Earth on book down and book on Earth up.
